summary: Sprint 10 — Gold Investment Platform backend validated end-to-end. All 15 required scenarios pass (quote structure/spread, buy 500 with wallet debit + notification + audit, Idempotency-Key single-debit, below-min 400, insufficient-wallet 400, sell half with realized_pnl and wallet credit, chart windows 1D/1W/1M/3M/1Y/ALL non-empty, transactions ?side=buy filter, manual price override -> mid=7000 provider=manual source=admin_override, maintenance_mode blocks buy, provider switching mock + augmont fallback, /api/admin/gold/providers returns all 5, admin dashboard totals, audit log entries for gold.buy/sell/config.updated, no KYC gate on buy/sell). Full regression suites iter27/28/30/32/33 (kyc_v2)/forex_regression/notifications all green (235 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failures). State reset to provider=live_market, manual_price=0, maintenance=false at teardown. No wallet double-debit observed; wallet delta matched tx amount to 1 paise in every case.
critical_code_review_comments: gold/engine.py: current_price() falls back correctly to live_market then mock. When chosen provider is a real-but-unconfigured stub (augmont/mmtc_pamp/safegold) with is_configured()==False, provider.price_per_gram() returns ok=True with source='<name>:fallback_live_market' — so the outer 'if not result.ok' fallback branch is bypassed and the returned quote has provider='augmont' source='augmont:fallback_live_market' (no explicit 'note' field). The review request accepts both shapes, so behavior is acceptable, but consider adding the same explanatory 'note' field for UX parity.

gold/engine.py: buy/sell wallet mutation and gold_transactions insert are not wrapped in a transaction — if the insert fails after $inc, the wallet would drift. Consider a compensating rollback or a Motor session/transaction. For MVP it is acceptable because DB writes are local and idempotent.
gold/engine.py: _guardrails raises when amount < min_buy_inr BEFORE the idempotency lookup — so a repeat POST with an amount below min will still hit 400 (this is fine).
gold/engine.py: holdings.total_invested is decremented by grams*avg_buy_price at sell time; if user sells all, total_invested correctly floors at 0 via max(0, ...).
gold/routes.py: BuyIn uses ge=1 (₹1 minimum via Pydantic) but engine enforces min_buy_inr=10 — this dual-gate is fine; the 422 vs 400 discrepancy is only for < ₹1 which is a corner case.

gold/providers.py: PROVIDER_REGISTRY lookup is case-insensitive on config but the PUT config accepts any string; consider validating provider in ('mock','live_market','augmont','mmtc_pamp','safegold') at the route level to fail fast.
gold/engine.py: _ensure_chart_seed inserts 400 seed points on first chart call — one-time cost but ok.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 gold; 235/236 combined incl. regression, 1 skipped unrelated)

seed_data_creation: None. Tests used existing demo user (demo@mfb.in) wallet balance and reset admin config to defaults on teardown (provider=live_market, manual_price=0, maintenance=false, max_buy=200000).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gold module lives at /app/backend/gold/{engine,providers,routes}.py and is attached via server.py ~L1155. Test suite is /app/backend/tests/test_gold_iter34.py — runnable with `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_gold_iter34.py`. Some sibling suites (test_iter28_market_providers.py, test_iter30_ai_news_analytics.py) hard-require EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to be exported in the environment or they abort at collection time — set it before invoking pytest at repo root. Test 05 (insufficient wallet) briefly bumps max_buy_inr to (wallet+500000) then resets to 200000 to avoid hitting the max-cap error first; keep this pattern if the wallet balance changes. All gold config was reset to defaults at module teardown (autouse fixture).
